implementation.empty_graph_policy: Zero support/evidence edges => status NOT-CHECKED, accepted false. Never reported as ACYCLIC.
implementation.support_edge_direction: src cites dst (src is supported by dst). Cycles are on support/evidence edges only. Contradiction edges are stored and counted separately and do not decide circular citation.

negative_controls.description: Same detector: silent on the diamond DAG, fires on the planted 3-node citation cycle with the exact path.
A council with zero evidence/support edges is NOT-CHECKED. Graph size is published so this cannot be confused with an acyclic graph.
A contradiction 2-cycle with zero support edges does not count as circular citation.
Probe 2's independent undirected walk flags the diamond; the directed support-cycle detector stays silent. That proves the diamond control is load-bearing.
